description: This file is a C++ test implementation for a WorkerPool system, including classes for managing test jobs, tasks, and a test administrator that runs automated tests on the worker pool, including job scheduling, revoking, and reporting.

classes.name: WorkerPoolTestAdministrator
classes.description: A class that manages a worker pool for testing, including job submission, scheduling, revoking, and reporting.

classes.name: WorkerPoolTestAdministrator::TestJobMetaData
classes.description: Metadata for individual test jobs, including JobId, RepeatCount, and Revoked status.

classes.name: WorkerPoolTestAdministrator::TesterTask
classes.description: A task representing a test job, capable of dispatching and updating its metadata.

classes.name: WorkerPoolTestAdministrator::MonitorTask
classes.description: A task that monitors the test jobs and triggers analysis.

classes.name: WorkerPoolTestAdministrator::WorkerPoolImplementation
classes.description: A custom implementation of the worker pool with a dispatcher for executing jobs.

methods.name: ResetAndActivateWorkerPool
methods.description: Resets and activates the worker pool with new parameters.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the test administrator by resetting and activating the worker pool.

methods.name: Notify
methods.description: Signals the event indicating test completion.

methods.name: WaitForTestCompletion
methods.description: Waits for the test to complete within a specified timeout.

methods.name: getRandomValue
methods.description: Generates a random value within a specified range.

methods.name: getNextJobId
methods.description: Generates the next unique job ID.

methods.name: SubmitTestJob
methods.description: Submits a new test job to the worker pool.

methods.name: UpdateJobDetails
methods.description: Updates the details of a job, scheduling or removing it based on its metadata.

methods.name: RevokeRandomJobs
methods.description: Randomly revokes a subset of active jobs.

methods.name: RescheduleRandomJobs
methods.description: Randomly reschedules active jobs for future execution.

methods.name: GenerateAndTestAutomatedJobs
methods.description: Generates a large number of test jobs and submits them for testing.

methods.name: GenerateTestReport
methods.description: Generates a report of the current test job statuses.

methods.name: AnalyseTestTask
methods.description: Analyzes the current state of test jobs and triggers rescheduling or revoking as needed.

methods.name: StartMonitorJob
methods.description: Starts the monitoring job that periodically checks test status.
